_meta.notes: ATTACHMENT-IS-THE-SCHEDULE, confirmed by reading every page: this PDF is exactly three pages - cover, Summary Page, and ONE typed filer sheet carrying BOTH schedules (contributions block on the top half, expenditures block on the bottom). There is NO county Schedule A page and NO county Schedule B page, and no 'See Attached' stub, so a wave keyed on finding a stub would have missed this filing entirely. shape.<side> is 'attachment-is-the-schedule' on both sides. THE OCCUPATION COLUMN EXISTS BUT UNDER THE FILER'S OWN SPELLINGS. The attachment's headers read 'Name: | Address | Employeer | Professon | Date | Amount'. 'Professon' is the occupation-equivalent and its value is what goes into each row's `occupation` field, verbatim; the separate 'Employeer' value is preserved in the row note. 9 of 14 contribution rows carry a Professon value; the other 5 are blank and on every one of those the filer left BOTH the Employeer and the Professon cell empty (three are his 'Agg Cash' aggregate lines, two are organisations) - each such row says so in its note. Nothing was inferred from a donor's name. THE COVER'S SIGNATURE DATE IS 3/15/16 AND THE FORM GOVERNS. The chunk file carries 2016-09-15. The form's checked Type-of-Report box IS 'September 15' and the clerk's stamp reads RECEIVED SEP 15 2016, but the filer's own signature date, re-read at 1200 dpi, is unambiguously 3/15/16. That is a well-formed filer typo and is kept VERBATIM in cover.report_date rather than silently corrected to September; the period label (September 15) and the received stamp are recorded here instead. AMENDMENT BOX: neither the 'Yes' nor the 'No' box is checked - is_amendment is honestly BLANK, not 'No'. THE SUMMARY PAGE'S OWN HEADER BOX IS ENTIRELY EMPTY - 'Page __ of __', 'Candidate or Officeholder's Last Name' and 'Date of Report' are all unfilled; the page is identified only by its position and by a struck-through 'Page 2' stamp above the box. The cover carries a matching 'Page 1' stamp. Neither is a form field. AGGREGATE ROWS: three rows read 'Agg Cash' - the filer's aggregate small-contribution lines (the local equivalent of the county form's '$50.00 & under' row). They are transcribed verbatim, are NOT people, carry no Employeer/Professon, and DO count toward the total (the block total closes to the cent with them in). TWO EXPENDITURE ROWS PRINT 'various' IN THE DATE CELL and three other rows print month/day-only or a suppressed-trailing-zero amount - all handled by the strict rules and noted per row. PRIVACY: the black bar covers the attachment's whole 'Address' column on the contributions block, so donor_city/donor_state are blank with 'redacted at source' on every row. The cover's own address block, phone and email are likewise barred. Nothing was inferred or backfilled.

contributions.detail: 14 rows sum to 38,080.55, equal to the unlabelled grand total printed under the attachment's Amount column (38080.55) and to Summary Page line 1 Column A (38,080.55). No page subtotal exists - the attachment is a single block on one page - so the block total IS the gate. No in-kind marker anywhere (the attachment has no in-kind column and the filer wrote none), so no schedule-total-vs-summary-gap.

expenditures.detail: 14 rows sum to 37,878.66, equal to the grand total printed under the block (37878.66) and to Summary Page line 2 Column A (37,878.66).

itemized.page_subtotal_gates: NO 'SUBTOTAL FOR THIS PAGE' EXISTS in this document - there is no county schedule page at all. Each of the two attachment blocks prints its own unlabelled grand total on the line below the last row, and both closed EXACTLY: contributions 14 rows = 38080.55; expenditures 14 rows = 37878.66. Both also equal their Summary Page Column-A figures.
itemized.escalation_note: 1200 dpi tight cell crop of the cover's signature Date cell, to settle whether the leading glyph is a 3 or a 9. It is a 3: two stacked open bowls, no closed loop. The date is recorded verbatim as 3/15/16 - see notes.
